clue.text: Has to accept wound in battle

indicators.note: to accept is to take in, so the word Has opens up to hold the other piece

parts.note: the clue word split around the insert
to sting is to wound

explanation.surface: Someone is told they must put up with an injury received in combat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to accept' puts STING inside HAS, split HA...S.
explanation.definitionFit: The Battle of Hastings in 1066 was where the Normans beat the English.

clue.text: Worry as Ian goes off

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone frets as a friend called Ian leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes off' reads as Ian departing, but only 'off' is the anagram signal; 'goes' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To agonise is to fret or torment oneself with anxiety.

clue.text: Tail coat and trousers?

parts.note: to tail someone is to track or follow them
a jacket and matching trousers make a suit

explanation.surface: A formal tailcoat paired with trousers, as at a wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tail coat' looks like the formal garment, but it is a verb, follow, plus coat-and-trousers as a two-piece outfit; together they describe athletic wear.
explanation.definitionFit: Sportswear is a top and bottoms for running about, so it is a two-piece outfit for following a running circuit.

clue.text: Either way it is unacceptable

indicators.note: either way says the answer reads the same from both directions

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A verdict that something is wrong whichever way you look at it.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for something that is not done or not allowed is a British colloquialism for impermissible.

clue.text: True progressive's prepared to be outspoken

parts.note: straight means true, as in a straight line
forward means progressive, as in forward-thinking

explanation.surface: A genuine reformer is ready to speak their mind plainly.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank, direct speech is both outspoken and plain-spoken.

clue.text: Reportedly wash out Italian bottle

definitions.meaning: a washout is a complete failure
in Italian the word is a flask, often straw-covered for Chianti

explanation.surface: An Italian wine flask has to be rinsed, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reportedly' signals that the second sense is the Italian word's meaning as reported; there is no sound-alike.
explanation.definitionFit: A humiliating disaster is a washout, and the Italian word is literally a straw-covered wine flask.

clue.text: Stuff and nonsense

definitions.meaning: a woollen fabric, stuff being cloth

explanation.definitionFit: It is a soft woollen cloth, and also evasive, empty talk meant to flatter or mislead.

clue.text: Almost none breaching border

indicators.note: breaching means breaking into, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to abut is to border on
O is a zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Nearly nobody crosses the frontier illegally.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughly or nearly, as in about ten people.

clue.text: Guarantee quarter invested in two businesses

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, so one piece sits within the pair

parts.note: CO is short for company, one business
a firm is another business
N, north, is a compass quarter

explanation.surface: A promise that a district's money has been put into a pair of companies.
explanation.definitionFit: To guarantee something is to make sure of it or ratify it.

clue.text: Last notes returning officer carries round

indicators.note: returning means the whole assembled piece is read backwards
carries means holds within, so one piece is inside the other

parts.note: ADC is an aide-de-camp, a military officer
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A returning officer at an election walks round with the final notes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning officer' looks like the election official; here 'returning' turns ADOC (O inside ADC) backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The closing passage of a piece of music is its final section of notes.

clue.text: Try a complete change of direction

parts.note: a turn is a go or try
round means complete, as in a round dozen

explanation.surface: An instruction to attempt a full reversal of course.
explanation.definitionFit: A reversal of policy or course is a full swing to face the other way.

clue.text: Squalid case-kid in terrible deprivation, ultimately

indicators.note: terrible suggests something mangled, so the letters before it are rearranged
ultimately points to the final letter of the word deprivation

explanation.surface: A grim story of a problem child living in awful poverty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' rearranges CASEKID and IN to DICKENSIA; 'ultimately' adds N.
explanation.definitionFit: Victorian-novel squalor, like the slums and workhouses in Oliver Twist, is called after that author.

clue.text: Spare item's reduced

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a thing is an item

explanation.surface: A spare item has been marked down in price.
explanation.definitionFit: Spare means lean or slight, as in a spare frame.

clue.text: Group found in Bergen usually

indicators.note: found in says the letters sit inside the run of words

explanation.surface: A remark about what is typically seen in the Norwegian city of Bergen.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology the rank between family and species is a classification group.

clue.text: Sound certain to be good?

parts.note: whole means sound, undamaged
some means certain, as in some people

explanation.surface: Asking whether something healthy-sounding is sure to be beneficial.
explanation.definitionFit: Healthy, morally good food or entertainment is wholesome.

clue.text: Personal reflection?

parts.note: reads as private thought, but means the picture one has of one's own person, as if in a mirror

explanation.definitionFit: How one sees oneself is a mental reflection of one's own person.

clue.text: Top discount for the relatively well-to-do?

parts.note: to better is to top or surpass
off means reduced, as in ten per cent off

explanation.surface: A best-price deal aimed at the comparatively wealthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Being more prosperous than others means comparatively wealthy.

clue.text: Note condition inside cube structure

parts.note: E is a musical note

indicators.note: inside means one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: dice are cubes
if introduces a condition

explanation.surface: A remark about the state of something within a cube.
explanation.definitionFit: A large, imposing building is a structure.

clue.text: Pressure in channel before northern river burst

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of the next in the answer
in puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: a rut is a groove or channel
P is the symbol for pressure
the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire, England

explanation.surface: Pressure built up in a channel before a river in the north burst its banks.
explanation.definitionFit: A breach or split is a burst.

clue.text: Tree said to be perpendicular

indicators.note: said signals a word that sounds the same as the tree

parts.note: a plum is a fruit tree

explanation.surface: Someone claims a tree stands upright.
explanation.definitionFit: Exactly vertical, as shown by a weighted line.

clue.text: Piecework?

parts.note: reads as work paid by the piece, but means a work made of pieces put together

explanation.definitionFit: A composite picture or film sequence assembled from fragments is a work of pieces.

clue.text: Old instrument I mostly love to play

indicators.note: to play suggests the letters frolic into a new order
mostly means all but the final letter

parts.note: taken as written before trimming

explanation.surface: Someone says they mostly love playing an early stringed instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims LOVE to LOV; 'to play' rearranges I and LOV.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowed stringed instrument of the Renaissance, ancestor of the modern string family.

clue.text: Conservative beset by temptation -money

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a lure is a temptation

explanation.surface: A Tory politician is surrounded by the temptation of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Filthy lucre is money, especially gained dishonestly.

clue.text: Aware commission will be cut by one Greek character

indicators.note: cut by means split open by, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: a percentage or cut is a commission
I is the Roman numeral one
pi is a Greek letter

explanation.surface: Someone notices their sales fee will be reduced by a Greek man.
explanation.definitionFit: Perceptive, discerning, quick to understand.

clue.text: I learn about resistance in French department

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: to see is to learn or understand
R is the symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: Someone studies the Resistance in a part of France.
explanation.definitionFit: A department in the Alps of south-east France, named after its river.

clue.text: Damaged cargo is due to be put off

indicators.note: damaged means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Damaged freight is set to be rejected.
explanation.definitionFit: To deter or dissuade is to put someone off.

clue.text: Middle Eastern block backing African leader at first

indicators.note: at first places that letter at the front of the answer
leader means the first letter of the word African
backing means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a bar is a block, as of soap

explanation.surface: A Middle Eastern bloc supports an African head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the people of the Arabian peninsula and Middle East.

clue.text: Composed love song, having missed promotion

indicators.note: having missed means something is left out

parts.note: a serenade is a love song
an ad promotes a product

explanation.surface: Someone wrote a love song after being passed over for a promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composed' looks like wrote, but it is the definition: calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm and unruffled, as a composed person is.

clue.text: Exploit involving English writer appeared more profound

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a deed is an exploit or feat
a pen is a writer

explanation.surface: An heroic feat involving an English author seemed deeper.
explanation.definitionFit: Grew deeper or more intense, as a mystery that thickens.
